description: The timesheet for a date range as a grid: one row per project, hours per day, totals per project and per day, and the weekdays with nothing logged. Optionally for one client or one project. Use this to 'show me my timesheet for last week' or to check a sheet before sharing it. Days marked non-billable still count here.

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

project.description: Only this project: id or "Client / Project"

name: get_timesheet

day_totals.description: Hours per date across the rows

days.description: The dates that have time logged, oldest first

hours_by_day.description: Hours per date, only dates with time

scope.description: The client or project the sheet is for, or All clients

weekdays_without_time.description: Monday to Friday dates in the range with nothing logged

title: Get a timesheet
